notes.title: Digital Pre-orders Now Open!
notes.content:
Starting today, digital pre-orders are available!
In addition to the standard edition, there is the Digital Deluxe Edition, which includes a set of costumes for Rias, Slade, and their friends, plus a Head Start Item Pack to help you progress smoothly through the early stages of the game.
Even more content awaits in the Ultimate Edition—featuring summer-themed costumes and additional playable characters, Resna and Valeria, from Atelier Resleriana!
Pre-order a digital edition by Thursday, September 25 to receive exclusive bonus costumes for Rias and Slade. Don’t miss out!

notes.title: System Introduction Video released!
notes.content:
A video that offers an in-depth look at the game system such as exploration, battle, synthesis, and shop management has been released. 
Make sure to watch this video that is full of the charm of Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian!
[previewyoutube=7apNcv4cvWw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Exploration[/b][/h3]
Freely roam around the Lantarna mainland while enjoying battles and gathering materials!
[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/2c89fd6fa87758c9793247656ba95d37ff7d2b40.jpg[/img][/p]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/c6323603afd10a8bcd4ffbe2bd6dd33c347690ba.jpg[/img]
Switch between character abilities to clear different terrains.
Equipping Exploration Equipment will automatically select the appropriate tool in gathering spot.

[h3][b]Exploration - multi-level dungeons known as “Dimensional Paths”[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/745354cbb36122ab590567708050e68a4a288fcf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/686307f0e959f5679ad3dd278f03971b9d05adb2.jpg[/img]
The layouts of Dimensional Paths are randomized with each visit, and the ingredients and enemies found within them change according to the difficulty level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/1d3ee68c233ab487b8d770fc160ff355b41ae762.jpg[/img]
“Starpearls” are rare items that can only be found within the Dimensional Paths, and have set effects as well as a random trait.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/f1fd228ae4d30fdbd2101008e15320ed3e5e793e.jpg[/img]
Furthermore, fairies might also appear within the Dimensional Paths! Speak to them to obtain useful items and employ them at Mistletoe Miscellaneous.

[h3][b]Battles[/b][/h3]
Enjoy strategic battles by taking advantage of effect panels on the timeline, inserting characters into the turn order, and switching between the front and back rows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/663ba36f976d900f1aad1efb234d7315f70b20fa.jpg[/img]
Spend TP to insert party members on the back row into the turn order by using “interrupts” or “Multi-Actions.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/c095c1960328ca0b0dcc16adb93283cb121a4ab3.jpg[/img]
When two or more items are used in a row, powerful additional attacks are unleashed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/f0e752752822ce0232c007ccf7024dd030fcc52d.jpg[/img]
Attacks accumulate Unite Gauge. If your Unite Gauge is at two or greater and the front row performs consecutive attacks, a “Unite Attack” will trigger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/0b0fa752bb1dfe8a038378e2094282a5d0af94a9.jpg[/img]
Attacks accumulate Unite Gauge. If your Unite Gauge is at two or greater and the front row performs consecutive attacks, a “Unite Attack” will trigger!

[h3][b]Synthesis[/b][/h3]
Create items through “Gift Color Synthesis” by linking the Gift Colors of ingredients. Furthermore, “Catalyst Ingredients” and “Recipe Morph” can be used to create even more specialized items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/295e5b88264018f99fe5c8feeaba1b91d7214448.jpg[/img]
Once all the required ingredients to create an item have been added, arrange ingredients can be added. Linking the Gift Colors of ingredients will their traits to the finished product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/4545b50f5404bf938f38feea31fa3cbdce8a5fcf.jpg[/img]
Catalyst ingredients that can be used arrange ingredients:
1) Altus: Sets the Gift Color for the next arrange slot.
2) Iris Stone: Changes the designated category of the next arrange slot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/b6079c9fc2d8c2faa3b05a7cbe89783d0a145376.jpg[/img]
Recipe Morph can also activate for certain recipes when specific ingredients are added as arrange ingredients!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/fc81f087f7b82e0f284d8afc0f151d6d596363df.jpg[/img]
After Recipe Morph, additional arrange ingredients can be added to make the synthesized item even stronger!

[h3][b]Synthesis - Strengthen the Items[/b][/h3]
Players can enhance each synthesized item one time by using Slade's Geist Core. Cooperate with three party members or fairies to create even stronger items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/372dea80d0508abf7d414a988c409d0bb656e905.jpg[/img]
Choose an equipment, item, or Starpearl to be enhanced. Please note that enhancing costs money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/03bf6d2e2d3263246fb22727bcee6aa620e1247d.jpg[/img]
Choose a Geist Core, which will grant various effects based on the type chosen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/dc17339a8f7b493315067881e1f41c8f2d1f0384.jpg[/img]
Add various traits based on the “Talents” of the three characters you've chosen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/edf946a4afe7185d95393374c8a921a106f39a48.jpg[/img]
Complete the enhancement! Create your own masterpieces by enhancing your favorite items!

[h3][b]Town Development and Shop Management[/b][/h3]
Sell items created through synthesis or found while exploring! 
Help boost the town's restoration activities by selling a variety of items, and then invest the profits and resources earned from the shop to develop the town further. As the town starts to bustle once again, reference books containing new synthesis recipes will be made available, and the story will develop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/349e0e1a63ebb8b54c8162d04c76b145073a6714.jpg[/img]
You can earn a bonus on the sales price by linking the Gift Colors when displaying the items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/6e8eeb241929504fe18354bec05fed7cdc019fad.jpg[/img]
The fairies have unique personalities so make sure to assign them to roles that suit their talents, while also keeping an eye on their stamina.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/20b1665e51c29f3d303cf3c28e9ff4d8fdbb797d.jpg[/img]
Talk to Ruku, and he will fill you in on tasks and market conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/6b834843426a50646eae259d9937517fc8f65bd9.jpg[/img]
You can also purchase items such as walls and floors to redecorate your store!

notes.title: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian coming Sept. 26!
notes.content:
This game can be enjoyed entirely offline, with no internet connection required.
This title sticks to the traditional Atelier series experience while also building upon it. 
Atelier fans can enjoy an evolution of the familiar synthesis and battle systems, culminating in a heartwarming story for all to enjoy.
*An internet connection is required to apply updates and additional content.
[previewyoutube=m2Y87-C8Cms;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]STORY[/b][/h3]
Two young adults return to their lost hometown in search of truth and to bring back what they hold dear.

The town of Hallfein was once situated at the border of three provinces, and thrived thanks to mining and trade. However, a mysterious disaster struck this peaceful town, causing most of its residents to disappear. The town became a restricted area, and only investigators dispatched from the capital were allowed to enter.

As time passed, restrictions on the town were lifted, and a plan to restore it was initiated. Seizing this opportunity, a young woman and a young man, having come of age after being driven from Hallfein long ago, now return to the land they once called home. The former hopes to restore the shop left behind by her missing grandfather, and the latter seeks to investigate the mementos left to him by his father. While their reasons for returning differ, they share one common goal: uncovering the cause of the townspeople's mysterious disappearance.

After meeting in their hometown, the two embark on a journey together to seek the truth,
unaware of the encounters and revelations that await them...
[p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/510a961f7d0a45b7bbfeee8bc2c0dc3e45ae6503.jpg[/img][/p]
